entries.123dc67927474a8e: A business for the nicotine- and tar-free electronic cigarette “SPADE” and similar products. Efforts to acquire new customers and various measures have ended, and the main revenue now comes from delivery of regular shipments to existing subscription customers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥46 million.

entries.75919b4345437a0d: The main business operated by the company, selling original-brand cosmetics, health foods and other products, developed from customers' specific concerns and needs, to general consumers mainly through its own EC site. It sells through EC malls such as Qoo10 and Rakuten Ichiba. Because it became a consolidated subsidiary in December 2025, revenue of ¥236 million for the fiscal year ended February 2026 covers the fourth quarter only.

It sells mainly through EC malls such as Amazon, Rakuten Ichiba and Qoo10, and also sells in stores at some electronics retailers and discount stores. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥898 million.
